title: SQL injection after semicolon strip in /q handler
summary: Form parameter n is semicolon-stripped then spliced into a LIKE query via string replace, defeating parameterization.

threat_model.attacker: authenticated or anonymous HTTP client posting to /q
threat_model.boundary: HTTP form n → SQLite text() execution
threat_model.impact: arbitrary SQL injection to read or modify items rows

patch_sketch: Bind parameters with sqlalchemy text() bindparams instead of string replace.
